documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Rolex Rings Limited reported its Q2 FY27 performance, achieving revenue from operations of Rs. 389 crore, up 43% year-on-year, supported by strong growth in automotive components and a one-time tariff refund of ~Rs. 18 crore. EBITDA grew 72% to Rs. 94 crore with margins reaching 24.2%, despite cost pressures from elevated ocean freight and fuel prices.

guidance.claim: Rolex Rings expects H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1.
guidance.quote: We expect H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1.

guidance.claim: Rolex Rings expects revenues from the defence and aerospace segment over the next 12 months.
guidance.quote: We have received registrations and initial approvals in defence and aerospace and expect revenues from this segment over the next 12 months.

guidance.claim: Rolex Rings remains confident of achieving mid-teen revenue growth guidance for FY27.
guidance.quote: Both this thing taken together, we remain confident in the mid-teen revenue growth guidance that we have given for fiscal '27.

guidance.claim: Management conservatively expects the FY27 EBITDA margin to be between 21% and 22%.
guidance.quote: We expect -- let me tell you conservatively, we expect that to be in the range of 21% to 22% in this fiscal FY27 conservatively.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue growth to approach close to 20% in FY28.
guidance.quote: On the revenue part, as I have indicated, mid-teen; we are a bit confident till now for fiscal '27 and maybe more than mid-teen or coming close to the 20% number for fiscal '28.

guidance.claim: Management issued a mid-teen growth guidance for the remainder of FY27.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, with the labour situation normalized, US re-engaging, and Europe continuing to build on our expanding automotive presence there, we head into the rest of FY27 with confidence with a mid-teen growth guidance and in our ambition to be the most trusted precision forging partner for the world's leading bearing and automotive OEMs

demand_outlook.claim: Automotive components led Q2 FY27 performance, growing 68% to Rs. 177 crore, with exports in this segment up 89%.
demand_outlook.quote: Automotive components led the quarter, growing 68% to Rs. 177 crore, with exports in this segment up 89%.

demand_outlook.claim: US automotive revenues for Rolex Rings more than doubled year-on-year in Q2 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Our US automotive revenues more than doubled year-on-year in Q2.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers who held back orders through FY26 are placing orders again and new programmes won last year are scaling up.
demand_outlook.quote: Customers who held back through FY26 are placing orders with confidence again, and the new programmes we won last year are now scaling up.

demand_outlook.claim: Rolex Rings is in discussions with a large OEM in Europe for commercial vehicle and industrial products.
demand_outlook.quote: In Europe, we continue to build on our expanding automotive presence and are in discussions with a large OEM for commercial vehicle and industrial products.

demand_outlook.claim: US market demand is improving as customers re-engage after a period of caution.
demand_outlook.quote: The US market is coming back with the customers reengaging after a prolonged period of caution.

demand_outlook.claim: Softness in bearing rings was primarily concentrated in the industrial segment across domestic and European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The bearing rings softness was concentrated in the industrial business or in the industrial segment, particularly in the domestic and European market, an area where we have flagged our broader industry-wide stagnancy in the past, and it reflects the same labor-driven output constraint that affected quarter too.

demand_outlook.claim: Overseas demand is picking up as cautious buyers from FY26 have resumed placing orders.
demand_outlook.quote: What stands out most is a change in customer behaviour - buyers who had been cautious and holding back through FY26 are now placing orders again with confidence.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that overseas demand is genuinely recovering.
demand_outlook.quote: This shift matters because it tells us that demand overseas is genuinely picking up.

demand_outlook.claim: Business in the US has not been affected by tariffs and is returning to normalcy.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite the US imposing tariffs, business has not been affected and is coming back to normalcy.

demand_outlook.claim: Export business was the primary highlight of Q1 FY27, making up more than half of component sales.
demand_outlook.quote: The real highlight of the quarter was our export business.

capex_expansion.claim: An additional 9MW solar plant is scheduled to be set up by mid-CY2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Additional 9MW solar plant to be setup by Mid - CY2026

capex_expansion.claim: Rolex Rings targets annual capex in the range of INR 30 crores to INR 40 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: In the range of INR30 crores to INR40 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by 220 bps to 55% and EBITDA grew 72% to Rs. 94 crore in Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by 220 bps to 55%, EBITDA grew 72% to Rs. 94 crore with margins at 24.2%, and PAT grew 68% to Rs. 74 crore considering one time receipt.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations included a one-time receipt of around Rs. 18 crore from US tariff customs duty refunds in Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue from operations grew 43% year-on-year to Rs. 389 crore, which includes a one-time receipt of around Rs. 18 crore from the refund of customs duty paid on US tariffs.

margins_costs.claim: Ocean freight experienced a near three-fold rise alongside higher fuel and consumable costs following West Asia conflict escalation.
margins_costs.quote: We delivered this despite a near three-fold rise in ocean freight ,higher fuel cost and consumable costs following the escalation of the West Asia conflict.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA increased 12% year-on-year to INR 69 crores with an EBITDA margin of 22.6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR69 crores. I'm not considering other income, which is up by 12% on comparing with the Q1 FY26, with the EBITDA margin at a percentage of 22.6%, which is up by 100 basis points, again, on comparing with Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 4% YoY to Rs. 304 crores alongside improving gross margins and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue grew by 4% to Rs. 304 crores with Gross Margins & profitability improving.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin stood at 56% in Q1 FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: Rolex Rings maintains a strong order book averaging Rs. 120 crores to Rs. 125 crores per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book continues to remain strong, averaging in the range of Rs.120 crores to Rs 125 crores per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilisation stands at 63-65%, providing room for growth.
orders_capacity.quote: One to two new customer plants begin supplies in Q3, new programmes continue to ramp up, and our capacity utilisation of 63-65% gives us ample room to grow.

orders_capacity.claim: Rolex Rings is operating at a capacity utilization level of 63% to 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: We are at the same 63% to 65% utilization, you can say.

orders_capacity.claim: The company recorded its highest-ever monthly revenue since inception in July 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: I would like to inform or pleased to inform that in month July '26, we recorded the highest revenue since the inception of our operations.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintained a healthy order book throughout Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stayed healthy through the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Rolex Rings has a total forging production capacity of 1,65,000 MTPA.

capital_allocation.claim: Rolex Rings has completed a buyback of Rs. 180 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: With a debt-free balance sheet, the Rs. 180 crore buyback completed, and a strong pipeline across Europe, the US and India, we head into H2 FY27 with confidence.

capital_allocation.claim: Rolex Rings completed an INR 180 crores buyback of 1 crore equity shares during the quarter without promoter participation.
capital_allocation.quote: Would like to inform you that our INR180 crores buyback of 1 crores equity shares concluded during the quarter, with the promoter group choosing not to participate so that the full benefit flowed directly to non-promoter shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is completely debt-free with all legacy CDR obligations cleared.
capital_allocation.quote: As of today, we are fully debt-free and clear of all legacy CDR obligations.

capital_allocation.claim: A Rs. 180 crore buyback concluded in Q1 FY27 without participation from the Promoter Group.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs. 180 crore buyback got concluded during the quarter, with the Promoter Group choosing not to participate so that the full benefit flowed to our public shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has become fully debt-free and cleared all legacy CDR obligations.
capital_allocation.quote: Aso of today, we are fully debt-free and clear of all legacy CDR obligations.

risks_headwinds.claim: US tariffs have not impacted business operations, and no customers have been lost due to tariffs.
risks_headwinds.quote: US tariffs have not impacted our business. Our US automotive revenues more than doubled year-on-year in Q2. Our relationships with US customers have stayed intact, and we have not lost a single customer to tariffs.

risks_headwinds.claim: A temporary shop floor labor shortage restricted the conversion of order book into finished output during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: A shortage of labor on the shop floor meant we could not convert that order book into output at the pace we wanted to.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operational throughput was constrained by labour availability on the shop floor rather than demand.
risks_headwinds.quote: The constraint was labour availability, not demand.

management_commitments.claim: Rolex Rings expects H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1.
management_commitments.quote: We expect H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1.

management_commitments.claim: Rolex Rings expects revenues from the defence and aerospace segment over the next 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: We have received registrations and initial approvals in defence and aerospace and expect revenues from this segment over the next 12 months.

management_commitments.claim: An additional 9MW solar plant is to be set up by mid-CY2026.
management_commitments.quote: Additional 9MW solar plant to be setup by Mid - CY2026

management_commitments.claim: Management reaffirmed its mid-teen revenue growth guidance for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Both this thing taken together, we remain confident in the mid-teen revenue growth guidance that we have given for fiscal '27.

management_commitments.claim: Rolex Rings targets reaching capacity utilization levels of 70% to 72%.
management_commitments.quote: We target to touch somewhere about 70%-72%

management_commitments.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins in FY28 to be 50 basis points higher than FY27 levels.
management_commitments.quote: Definitely, the second portion, 50 basis points up on the FY27 number, would be there in FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Management has given a mid-teen growth guidance heading into the rest of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, with the labour situation normalized, US re-engaging, and Europe continuing to build on our expanding automotive presence there, we head into the rest of FY27 with confidence with a mid-teen growth guidance and in our ambition to be the most trusted precision forging partner for the world's leading bearing and automotive OEMs

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
